title: Cryptlet
statementMd:
The 5 Latin letters a-e have each been assigned a distinct digit between 0-9. Given an expression involving the sum of two numbers written as X+Y=Z (each number having the same number of digits, at most 1000, including any leading zeroes), written using letter substitutions, print plausible values for the assignments of all 5 letters in order from a-e as a string of 5 characters.

For instance, given `ab+ac=ca`, you may choose to output `18364`. Or, given `aaa+bbb=eee`, you may output `45789`.

## Input

- The only line of input contains a string of lowercase letters in `[a-e]` and symbols, of the form 𝑋+𝑌=𝑍 and with no spaces, where 1≤(|𝑋|=|𝑌|=|𝑍|)≤1000.

## Output

If no assignment is possible, output `impossible`.

Otherwise, output any string of 5 distinct digits which gives plausible values for the letters 𝑎, 𝑏, 𝑐, 𝑑, and 𝑒 respectively.
